global_outcome_basis.detail: 8665 of 9747 reviewed field-class/property-path relation pairs remain UNRESOLVED and may not be promoted to positive semantic relation evidence.
The matrix relation-domain field-class vocabulary and unit-inventory field-class vocabulary remain distinct traceability domains; no silent name-based merge is permitted.
Candidate carrier families, screening flags, and traceability bindings are context for search and do not themselves establish a unit-level lossless composition witness.
The bound evidence does not prove a complete joint assignment satisfying coexistence, collision, overwrite, and semantic-independence constraints for all 109 semantic units.

Decision 0102 requires all 17 losslessness requirements to be in scope, but the two bound formalization inputs do not expose a unique machine-discoverable 17-item requirement inventory. Requirement-level exhaustive closure therefore cannot be claimed.

interpretation: The complete 57-by-171 reviewed field-class relation domain is available, but the bound evidence does not support a sound complete whole-V4 composition universe without promoting unresolved relations, equating distinct field-class vocabularies, or treating screening/storage capacity as semantic proof. The study therefore terminates conservatively as FURTHER_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED rather than manufacturing a positive witness or negative impossibility result.
